description: This file defines utility functions and types for handling keyboard shortcut keybindings in a VSCode extension, including reading user configurations, default keybindings from package.json, and formatting key strings for display.

methods.name: getKeybindingsForCommands
methods.description: Retrieves keybindings for a list of commands, prioritizing user-defined keybindings and falling back to defaults.

methods.name: getKeybindingForCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the keybinding for a specific command, considering user configuration and defaults.

methods.name: getDefaultKeybindingForCommand
methods.description: Fetches the default keybinding for a command from package.json, formatted for the current platform.

methods.name: findAnyBindingForCommand
methods.description: Finds any keybinding entry matching a specific command from a list of keybinding entries.

methods.name: prettyPrintKey
methods.description: Formats a raw key string into a human-readable keybinding string.

methods.name: mapModifierKey
methods.description: Maps a modifier key to its platform-specific display name.

methods.name: mapSpecialKey
methods.description: Maps a special key to its display name.

methods.name: capitalizeKey
methods.description: Capitalizes a key for display purposes.

methods.name: normalizeKeyToken
methods.description: Normalizes a key token to its display format, considering modifiers and special keys.
